summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to redesign NutriPath's onboarding flow into the full multi-step Lifesum onboarding experience. Includes welcome inspiration with social proof, weight goals, multi-select lifestyle priorities, biometrics (gender, age, weight/height), dedicated clinical condition and allergy safety steps, interstitial affirmation, speed of change slider, animated 0-100% plan generation calculation, and personalized plan reveal with Google Sign-In, Email/Password, or Guest continuation. Styled in Lifesum's warm cream and vibrant emerald green aesthetic.
